scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Detective Morris
dialogues.text: The worker is cleared. I have spoken to his family. We will not use a frightened man's name to make this case look further along.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The trace does not belong to the person who left it here.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then the worker did not come back that morning?

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: No. Someone wanted us to think he had.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Tell his wife before she hears another rumour.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We will keep the planted material. Finding the lie has told us what someone wanted us to do.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
